settings.title: Settings
settings.notAvailable: This settings section is not available yet.
settings.chooseVerificationMethod: How would you like to verify?
settings.invalidRecoveryKey: That recovery key was not accepted.
settings.setUpRecoveryDescription: Save a recovery key so you can restore encrypted messages on a new device.
settings.resetRecoveryKeyDescription: Create a new recovery key if you lost yours.
settings.saveRecoveryKeyDescription: Store this key somewhere safe. It will not be shown again.
settings.removeDeviceDescription: It will be signed out and will no longer receive new messages.
settings.acceptOtherDevice: Accept the request on your other device.
settings.compareEmoji: Check these emoji match on both devices, in the same order.
settings.actionFailed: Could not complete that action. Please try again.
settings.enterPassword: Enter your password to remove this device.
settings.verificationUnavailable: Verification is not available yet. Make sure another signed-in device is online.
settings.timelineDescription: Choose which events appear in the conversation.
settings.hideMembershipEventsHint: Membership changes stay out of the timeline.
settings.hideProfileChangesHint: A member editing their profile no longer interrupts the conversation.
settings.hideMemberInReadOnly: Hide member events in read-only rooms
settings.hideMemberInReadOnlyHint: Announcement rooms stay free of joins, leaves and profile edits.
settings.showTombstoneEventsHint: Keeps a placeholder where a message was removed.
settings.layoutHint: Modern keeps a full avatar column; compact and bubble are denser.
settings.developerDescription: Raw event controls, off unless you are debugging.
settings.showHiddenEventsHint: Unlocks the raw event controls below.
settings.showNonStandardEventsHint: Renders state and custom events as a debug stream.
settings.stateEventDescription: Writes raw room state. The server is the only thing validating it, so prefer the typed controls in room settings.
settings.stateEventInvalidJson: Content must be a JSON object.
settings.themeHint: Follow the system, or pin light or dark.
settings.messageSpacingHint: How much room each message gets in the timeline.
settings.underlineLinksHint: Off leaves links coloured only, underlined on hover.
settings.timeDescription: How timestamps and day separators read.
settings.hour24ClockHint: Off follows the clock your system locale uses.
settings.dateFormatHint: Applies to day separators. Today and yesterday stay named.
settings.hideReadReceiptsHint: Stops showing who has read up to where. You still send your own.
settings.hideTypingIndicatorsHint: Nobody typing is announced above the composer.
settings.composerDescription: How the message box behaves as you write.
settings.enterForNewlineHint: Shift+Enter sends instead. Handy on touch keyboards.
settings.formattingToolbarHint: Keeps the bold, italic and list controls always open.
settings.privacyDescription: What Sable tells other people about you.
settings.sendTypingNotificationsHint: Off means others never see that you are writing.
settings.sendReadReceiptsHint: Off stops publishing how far you have read. Your own unread counts stop advancing too.
settings.sendPresenceHint: Publishes when you are online and when you were last active.
settings.errorReportingHint: Sends crash details when something breaks. Never messages, room names, or who you talk to. Takes effect after a reload.
settings.sessionReplayHint: Adds a replay of what you clicked before a crash. All text, media and inputs are masked before it leaves your device.
settings.telemetryBannerBody: Send error reports when something breaks? They never include messages, room names, or who you talk to.
settings.telemetryReloadNotice: Reload for the error reporting change to take effect.
settings.mediaDescription: What loads on its own in the timeline.
settings.mediaAutoLoadHint: Off shows a placeholder you tap to download.
settings.autoplayGifsHint: Off plays them only while hovered.
settings.urlPreviewsHint: Asks the server to unfurl links posted in a room.
settings.notificationsDescription: When and how Sable interrupts you.
settings.desktopNotificationsHint: Hands alerts to your operating system.
settings.notificationSoundsHint: Plays a sound for mentions and direct messages.
settings.notificationContentHint: Off shows only the room and sender in the alert.
settings.notificationDefaultsHint: Applies to rooms you have not set individually. Stored on your account, so every session follows it.
settings.notificationDefaultsFailed: Those notification settings could not be saved.
settings.notificationPermission: Your browser has not allowed notifications yet.
settings.pushGatewayHint: Where your homeserver sends notifications when Sable is closed. Leave these blank to use the gateway this deployment ships with.
settings.pushGatewayIncomplete: All three fields are needed before a custom gateway is used — a gateway only serves the application ID and VAPID key its own configuration names. Until then the default stands.
settings.pushGatewayWarning: This gateway receives a notification for every message you would be alerted about. Turn off “Show message content” to send it only a room and event ID.
settings.pushGatewayUnsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications, so no gateway is used.
settings.pushGatewayNotAUrl: That is not a web address.
settings.pushGatewayNotAGateway: A push gateway is an https address ending in /_matrix/push/v1/notify, with no username or fragment.
